sn17.12:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || Idāham bhikkhave ekaccam puggalam evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi || na cāyam āyasmā rūpiyapātiyāpi suvaṇṇacuṇṇaparipūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyāti || || Tam enaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtam pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ || || Evam dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
